situations.title: SBAR 구조 인계 기초
situations.tagline: I'm taking over Bed 3 — go ahead and give me your SBAR.
situations.brief: SBAR 구성요소를 순서대로 빠짐없이 전달하며 인계의 기본 틀을 익히세요.
keyPhrases: Situation: he's a sixty-year-old with sepsis, day two.
Background, assessment, and then my recommendation.
Let me know if you want me to repeat anything.

situations.title: 활력·주입약 인계
situations.tagline: What pressors and sedation is she on, and at what rates?
situations.brief: 승압제와 진정제 목록을 용량과 함께 정확히 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: She's on norepinephrine at eight, titrating to a MAP of sixty-five.
Propofol is running at thirty for sedation.
Her pressure's been stable for the last two hours.
goals: 승압제와 진정제 목록을 용량과 함께 전달한다

situations.title: 라인·장치 목록 인계
situations.tagline: Walk me through all his lines and tubes before you leave.
situations.brief: 라인과 튜브의 종류·위치·상태를 목록으로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: He has a right IJ central line and a left radial art line.
The Foley's draining well and the NG is to low suction.
The central line dressing was changed this morning.
goals: 모든 라인과 튜브의 위치와 상태를 전달한다

situations.title: 간호 문제·계획 인계
situations.tagline: What are the top priorities for her this shift?
situations.brief: 우선순위에 따라 간호 문제와 계획을 정리해 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Top priority is her respiratory status — watch her weaning trial.
She's due for a repeat lactate at eight.
Family wants an update when the doctor rounds.

situations.title: 알레르기·주의사항 전달
situations.tagline: Any allergies or precautions I need to know about right away?
situations.brief: 알레르기와 안전 주의사항을 명확히 강조해 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: She's allergic to penicillin — it causes anaphylaxis.
She's a fall risk and on contact precautions for MRSA.
There's a latex allergy flag on her chart too.

situations.title: 인계 중 확인질문 응대
situations.tagline: Let me read that back — the heparin's at twelve units per kilo, right?
situations.brief: 인계 중 오는 간호사의 확인질문에 read-back으로 정확히 응대하세요.
keyPhrases: Yes, that's correct — twelve units per kilo per hour.
Good catch, let me clarify that dose.
Read it back to me so we're both sure.

situations.title: ROSC 후 환자 인계
situations.tagline: He just got ROSC — give me the arrest details and the plan.
situations.brief: 심정지 후 회복된 환자의 상태와 계획을 압축적으로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Down time was about ten minutes with two rounds of epi.
He's post-arrest, intubated, and we're starting TTM.
Next steps are a twelve-lead, labs, and neuro checks.

situations.title: OR에서 ICU 수술후 인계
situations.tagline: Post-op from the OR — do you want the report now or once he's settled?
situations.brief: 수술실로부터 수술후 환자를 SBAR로 인계받고 출혈과 라인을 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Give me the SBAR — situation, background, assessment, recommendation.
What were the estimated blood loss and last pressor doses?
Let me read back the lines and drips to confirm.
goals: 수술후 핵심 정보를 SBAR로 빠짐없이 인수한다

situations.title: cath lab에서 ICU 인계
situations.tagline: He's back from the cath lab — here's what they did and his anticoagulation.
situations.brief: 시술 내용과 항응고 상태를 확인하며 cath lab로부터 인계받으세요.
keyPhrases: What was done in the cath lab and how's the access site?
Is he on a heparin drip, and what's his current ACT?
Let me read back the sheath status and hold parameters.

situations.title: ICU에서 병동 전동 인계
situations.tagline: She's stable enough for the floor — I'll take report on the remaining risks.
situations.brief: 안정화된 환자를 병동으로 전동하며 잔여 위험을 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: She's off pressors and weaned to nasal cannula.
Watch for her blood sugars and her fall risk on the floor.
Her central line comes out today if labs are stable.
goals: 안정화 경과와 현재 상태를 요약해 전달한다

situations.title: night shift 인계 우선순위
situations.tagline: It's a busy board tonight — what do I need to stay ahead of overnight?
situations.brief: 야간 근무의 주의점을 우선순위로 정리해 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Bed 5 is your sickest — he may need pressors titrated overnight.
Labs are due at four, and he's on a two-hourly neuro check.
If his pressure drops, page the resident early.

situations.title: 다학제 라운드 발표
situations.tagline: Go ahead and present Bed 4 by systems for the team.
situations.brief: 시스템별로 환자 상태를 요약해 다학제 라운드에서 발표하세요.
keyPhrases: Neuro: sedated but following commands off sedation.
Respiratory: on pressure support, tolerating weaning.
Plan: continue diuresis and reassess extubation tomorrow.

situations.title: 응급실에서 ICU 입실 인계
situations.tagline: Bringing you a septic shock admit from the ED — here's the initial resus.
situations.brief: 응급실로부터 입실하는 환자의 초기 소생 요약을 인계받으세요.
keyPhrases: How much fluid has he had and what's his lactate trend?
Is he on any pressors coming up from the ED?
Let me confirm his lines, antibiotics, and last vitals.

situations.title: 검사·시술 후 인계
situations.tagline: She's back from her procedure — let me tell you what changed and what to follow.
situations.brief: 검사·시술 후 변화와 후속 관찰 항목을 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: The bronchoscopy is done and samples are sent.
Watch her oxygen and for any post-procedure bleeding.
Repeat her chest X-ray was ordered for placement.

situations.title: 불안정 환자 인계 강조점
situations.tagline: This one's shaky — what are the triggers that should make me worried?
situations.brief: 급변 대비를 위해 불안정 환자의 강조점을 분명히 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: If his MAP drops below sixty-five, start pressors and call me.
His rhythm's been irritable — watch for runs of VT.
Escalate early rather than waiting on this one.
goals: 급변 위험 요인과 임계치를 명확히 전달한다

situations.title: 급변 중 긴급 인계
situations.tagline: I'm jumping in — just give me the critical stuff, fast.
situations.brief: 급변 상황에서 핵심만 압축해 긴급하게 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Septic shock, MAP forty, max norepi, adding vaso now.
Airway's secure, last gas showed acidosis.
I need you to push fluids while I call the doctor.
goals: 급변 상황의 핵심 정보만 즉시 전달한다

situations.title: 코드 상황 인계·역할
situations.tagline: I've got the code — tell me where we are and what my role is.
situations.brief: 소생 중 현재 상황과 역할을 명확히 인계하고 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: We're on round three, last rhythm was PEA.
You take compressions, I'll manage the airway.
Epi's been given, next dose in two minutes.

situations.title: 병원간 전원 인계
situations.tagline: This is the accepting facility — I'll take report before the transport team leaves.
situations.brief: 병원간 전원에서 인수를 조율하고 정보를 정확히 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll give a full SBAR and fax the records ahead.
He's stable for transport on these drips at these rates.
Please confirm you have the imaging and blood results.
goals: 전원 시 핵심 정보를 정확히 전달한다

situations.title: 정보 누락·오류 정정 인계
situations.tagline: Wait — the prior report had his potassium wrong; I need to correct that now.
situations.brief: 인계 중 발견된 정보 누락이나 오류를 즉시 정정해 안전을 회복하세요.
keyPhrases: I need to correct the last handoff — his potassium is actually 6.2.
That dose in the report was wrong; here's the accurate one.
Let's document the correction so it doesn't get missed.

situations.title: 임종·목표변경 인계
situations.tagline: Before you take over, you need to know his goals just changed to comfort care.
situations.brief: 목표가 변경된 임종 환자의 민감한 정보를 존중과 정확함으로 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: His code status changed to DNR and we're now comfort-focused.
The family is at bedside and needs gentle support.
Comfort meds are ordered — here's the titration plan.
goals: 임종 돌봄과 가족 지지 계획을 인계한다

situations.title: 다수 중환자 동시 인계 우선화
situations.tagline: You've got three sick ones tonight — help me prioritize before you go.
situations.brief: 다수 중환자를 동시에 인계하며 우선순위로 부하를 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Bed 3 is the sickest and needs the closest eye.
Bed 5 is stable but has labs due at midnight.
If two go off at once, call for help early.
goals: 과부하 시 지원 요청 기준을 공유한다
